candidate: Test increasing an existing winning cloud position using only the profit protected by its already-active trailing stop. No averaging down, no borrowing and no extra initial risk budget on the additions.
single_variable: Allow one additional market order on each later completed 12H boundary where the existing protection has ratcheted above its previous add level and the just-completed close and executable open are both better than the previous actual entry. The reference is the original 25% peak-retention full runner: arms at +2R, protects the greater of +0.5R or 25% of already completed H1 maximum favorable excursion. Retain all original exits. Use the pre-existing 25% trailing rule (the least aggressive positive retention that was previously tested).
sizing: At each add hold enough marked profit at the currently active protective stop to cover the entire previously paid entry fees plus the cost of liquidating all legs there. Maximum add quantity is that surplus divided by the new per-unit loss to the same stop, capped by one share of currently free collateral, splitting it equally between this add and each still-flat original slot and one original filled contract quantity. Deduct real market fees on all entries and exits. A gap through a protective stop may realize a loss. Multiple adds remain in the same parent and close together.
execution: 1000U, cash sharing, original nine slots, no leverage, low prior ATR. Process original openings, original opening-tick exits, then eligible add-ons, then native intrabar/close exits. Pending original slots retain equal access to free collateral. The baseline and add-on candidate use identical reference clocks, original capacity policy and native OHLC. No add without contiguous pre-decision quotes. Report per-parent cash payoff and compounding, bound and observed drawdown. Stress extra 5bp if development passes. No funding or lot rounding. OKX pilot; no live changes.
